title: Planning A Nepal Trip This Year? This New Indian Currency Rule Could Matter - NDTV Profit
description: Planning A Nepal Trip This Year? This New Indian Currency Rule Could Matter  NDTV Profit
publisher.title: NDTV Profit
full_article:
If you are planning a trip to Nepal, here is some good news for you. Nepal has allowed Indian and Nepalese nationals to carry Indian currency notes of Rs 200 and Rs 500 denominations, up to a total value of Rs 25,000 per person, provided the notes were issued on or after November 9, 2016.

In a notice issued on Thursday, the Nepal Rashtra Bank (NRB) said Indian currency notes of Rs 500 and Rs 1,000 denominations issued before November 9, 2016, remain prohibited in Nepal.

Though the provision was first notified through the Nepal Gazette on February 11, the central bank issued a fresh notice on Thursday reiterating the rules and clarifying its implementations.

How will this move affect Indian tourists?

India is Nepal's largest trading partner and its biggest source of tourists. India and Nepal share an open border and close people-to-people ties, with thousands of tourists, pilgrims, traders and workers traveling between the two countries every year. The move is expected to make travel between the two neighbouring countries more convenient by easing restrictions on the movement of Indian currency.

Thousands of Nepalese citizens also work, study and conduct business in India. The revised rule is expected to significantly ease currency related challenges for Indian tourists and pilgrims visiting Nepal, while also benefiting Nepali medical tourists and migrant workers travelling to India.

The change addresses a long standing demand in Nepal, where restrictions on high-value Indian currency had affected tourism, particularly hospitality businesses that cater to Indian visitors.

Nepal had imposed restrictions on the use and movement of old Indian currency notes, after India had demonetised Rs 500 and Rs 1,000 currency notes on November 8, 2016, replacing them with redesigned Rs 500 notes and introducing new Rs 2,000 notes. The Rs 2,000 notes have since been withdrawn from circulation.

The NRB spokesperson Guru Prasad Paudel further clarified on Saturday that Nepalese nationals cannot bring Indian currency into Nepal from any other country other than India, according to PTI. Similarly, they cannot carry Indian currency from Nepal to a third country, except India.

The notice also said Nepalese nationals and foreign visitors can bring up to $5,000 or its equivalent in other foreign currencies into Nepal without making a customs declaration. Any amounts exceeding $5,000 must be declared to customs upon arrival.

भारत नेपालक सबसँ पैघ व्यापारिक भागीदार आ पर्यटकक सबसँ पैघ स्रोत अछि । भारत आरू नेपाल केरऽ खुला सीमा आरू घनिष्ठ जन-जन संबंध छै, जेकरा म॑ हर साल हजारों पर्यटक, तीर्थयात्री, व्यापारी आरू मजदूर दूनू देशऽ के बीच यात्रा करै छै । उम्मीद छै कि ई कदम स॑ भारतीय मुद्रा केरऽ आवाजाही प॑ लगालऽ गेलऽ प्रतिबंध क॑ कम करी क॑ दूनू पड़ोसी देशऽ के बीच यात्रा क॑ अधिक सुविधाजनक बनाबै के उम्मीद छै ।

title: Nagdhunga-Sisnekhola tunnel inaugurated - The Rising Nepal
description: Nagdhunga-Sisnekhola tunnel inaugurated  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Kathmandu, July 27: The Nagdhunga-Sisnekhola Tunnel has been formally inaugurated today. Minister for Infrastructure Development Sunil Lamsal, Ambassador of Japan to Nepal Toru Maeda and President of the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) Akihiko Tanaka, jointly inaugurated the 2,688 metres long tunnel.

On the occasion, JICA President Tanaka described the Nagdhunga-Sisnekhola Tunnel Project as a historic and transformative achievement in Nepal's transport development journey. He noted that the project is not merely about infrastructure construction but marks the beginning of a new chapter in Nepal-Japan cooperation.

According to him, a new technical cooperation project has been launched between Nepal and Japan to enhance capacity regarding tunnel planning, construction, operation, and maintenance. The JICA President expressed the belief that the recently approved project would further expand cooperation between the two countries in tunnel infrastructure development.

Noting that this year marks the 70th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between Nepal and Japan, President Tanaka stated that the relationship—built on mutual trust, respect, and cooperation—has continued to strengthen over the past seven decades. He remarked that the Nagdhunga Tunnel stands as a living symbol of the enduring friendship and cooperation between the two nations.

Ambassador Maeda said the tunnel construction was completed through the Japanese government's Official Development Assistance (ODA) and the tireless efforts of Nepali technical personnel and workers. He noted that this project has further strengthened the trust and long-standing partnership between the governments of Nepal and Japan.

Expressing gratitude to all individuals and organizations that contributed to the project, Ambassador Maeda voiced his belief that the technical knowledge, skills, and high safety standards transferred through this initiative would play a significant role in Nepal's future tunnel and infrastructure development. He added that the primary objective of this collaboration is to build Nepal's capacity to operate and maintain tunnels independently in the years to come.

Secretary at the Ministry of Infrastructure Development, Gopal Prasad Sigdel, said that although the Nagdhunga checkpoint has served as the western gateway to the Kathmandu Valley for decades, it has long been known for heavy traffic congestion and a hazardous road section.

He asserted that the operation of the tunnel would significantly reduce travel time and alleviate the long-standing problems of traffic congestion and the risky travel.

Secretary Sigdel added that this historic project was successfully completed because Japanese and Nepali engineers worked shoulder to shoulder amidst topographical complexities and technical challenges.

Although the project was originally scheduled for completion by April 26, 2023, construction was hampered by delays on the part of the contractor, the COVID-19 pandemic, and local obstructions. The construction period for the project—for which the contract was signed on November 14, 2019—was most recently extended until October 25, 2025.

Previously, the government had determined the fees for vehicles using the tunnel by publishing a notice in the Nepal Gazette on April 9, 2026.

According to the notice, the fee for cars, vans, pickups, tractors, microbuses, and other light vehicles is set at Rs 65 for entering Kathmandu and Rs 60 for exiting. Entry and exit fees for minibuses and mini-trucks have been determined at Rs 125 and Rs 80 respectively; for buses and single rear-axle trucks at Rs 260 and Rs 200 respectively; and for multi-axle trucks and heavy equipment at Rs 600 and Rs 250 respectively.

The Nagdhunga-Sisnekhola tunnel—Nepal's first road tunnel—is expected to reduce travel time along the Kathmandu-Naubise road section and make a significant contribution to safe, convenient, and sustainable road transport management. (RSS)

काठमांडू, २७ जुलाई : नागधुंगा-सिस्नेखोला सुरंगके आइ औपचारिक उद्घाटन भेल अछि । पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्री सुनील लमसाल, नेपालमे जापानके राजदूत तोरू माएदा आ जापान अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय सहयोग एजेन्सी (जाइका)के अध्यक्ष अकिहिको तनाका संयुक्त रुपमे २६८८ मिटर लम्बा सुरंगके उद्घाटन केने छल ।

एहि अवसर पर जाइका अध्यक्ष तनाका नेपालक परिवहन विकास यात्रा मे नागधुंगा-सिसनेखोला सुरंग परियोजना ऐतिहासिक आ परिवर्तनकारी उपलब्धि बतौलनि । हुनी कहलकै कि ई परियोजना खाली बुनियादी ढांचा निर्माण के बारे मँ नै छै बल्कि नेपाल-जापान सहयोग मँ एगो नया अध्याय के शुरुआत छेकै ।

हुनकऽ अनुसार सुरंग योजना, निर्माण, संचालन, आरू रखरखाव के संबंध म॑ क्षमता बढ़ाबै लेली नेपाल आरू जापान के बीच एगो नया तकनीकी सहयोग परियोजना शुरू करलऽ गेलऽ छै । जाइका अध्यक्ष नँ ई विश्वास व्यक्त करलकै कि हाल मँ मंजूर करलौ गेलौ परियोजना स॑ सुरंग बुनियादी ढाँचा विकास मँ दूनू देशौ के बीच सहयोग मँ आरू विस्तार होतै ।

ई साल नेपाल आरू जापान के बीच कूटनीतिक संबंध के स्थापना के ७० साल पूरा होय गेलऽ छै, ई बात प॑ ध्यान दैत॑ हुअ॑ राष्ट्रपति तनाका न॑ कहलकै कि ई संबंध- जे आपसी विश्वास, सम्मान, आरू सहयोग प॑ बनलऽ छै – पिछला सात दशक स॑ लगातार मजबूत होय रहलऽ छै । हुनी टिप्पणी करलकै कि नागधुंगा सुरंग दूनू राष्ट्र के बीच स्थायी दोस्ती आरू सहयोग के जीवंत प्रतीक के रूप मँ खड़ा छै ।

राजदूत माएदा जापान सरकारक आधिकारिक विकास सहायता (ओडीए) आ नेपाली तकनीकी कर्मी आ मजदूरक अथक प्रयाससँ सुरंग निर्माण सम्पन्न भेल बतौलनि । ओ नोट केलथि जे एहि परियोजना स नेपाल आ जापान सरकार क बीच विश्वास आ दीर्घकालीन साझेदारी आओर मजबूत भेल अछि।

परियोजना म॑ योगदान दै वाला सब व्यक्ति आरू संगठनऽ के प्रति आभार व्यक्त करतें हुअ॑ राजदूत माएदा न॑ अपनऽ विश्वास के आवाज उठैलकै कि ई पहल के माध्यम स॑ हस्तांतरित तकनीकी ज्ञान, कौशल, आरू उच्च सुरक्षा मानक नेपाल केरऽ भविष्य केरऽ सुरंग आरू बुनियादी ढांचा के विकास म॑ महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाबै वाला छै । ओ आगू कहलनि जे, एहि सहयोगक प्राथमिक उद्देश्य आगामी वर्ष मे स्वतंत्र रूप सँ सुरंग संचालन आ रखरखाव करबाक लेल नेपालक क्षमताक निर्माण अछि ।

पूर्वाधार विकास मन्त्रालयके सचिव गोपाल प्रसाद सिग्देल नगढुंगा नाका दशकोंसे काठमांडू उपत्यकाके पश्चिम प्रवेश द्वारके रुपमे कार्यरत रहला पर भी बहुत दिनसँ भारी यातायातके भीड आ खतरनाक सडक खंडके लेल जानल जाइत रहल बटैलै ।

हुनी जोर देलकै कि सुरंग के संचालन स॑ यात्रा के समय म॑ काफी कमी आबै वाला छै आरू यातायात के भीड़ आरू जोखिम भरलऽ यात्रा के लंबा समय स॑ चलै वाला समस्या म॑ कमी ​​आबै वाला छै ।

सचिव सिग्डेल न॑ आरू कहलकै कि ई ऐतिहासिक परियोजना सफलतापूर्वक पूरा होय गेलै, कैन्हेंकि जापानी आरू नेपाली इंजीनियर न॑ स्थलाकृतिक जटिलता आरू तकनीकी चुनौती के बीच कंधा स॑ कंधा मिला क॑ काम करलकै ।

हालांकि मूल रूप स इ परियोजना 26 अप्रैल 2023 तक पूरा हेबाक छल, मुदा ठेकेदार क दिस स देरी, कोविड-19 महामारी, आ स्थानीय बाधा क कारण निर्माण मे बाधा पहुंचल। परियोजना केरऽ निर्माण अवधि-जकरऽ अनुबंध प॑ १४ नवंबर, २०१९ क॑ हस्ताक्षर करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै-सबसे हाल म॑ २५ अक्टूबर २०२५ तलक बढ़ालऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।

एहि सं पहिने सरकार 9 अप्रैल 2026 के नेपाल राजपत्र मे सूचना प्रकाशित क सुरंग के उपयोग करय वाला वाहन के शुल्क निर्धारित केने छल.

नोटिस के अनुसार कार, वैन, पिकअप, ट्रैक्टर, माइक्रोबस, आ अन्य हल्का वाहन के शुल्क काठमांडू में प्रवेश के लेल 65 रुपैया आ बाहर निकलय के लेल 60 रुपैया निर्धारित कयल गेल अछि। मिनीबस आ मिनी ट्रक क प्रवेश आ निकास शुल्क क्रमशः 125 आ 80 टका निर्धारित कैल गेल अछि; बस आ सिंगल रियर-एक्सल ट्रक लेल क्रमशः 260 आ 200 टका; आ मल्टी एक्सल ट्रक आ भारी उपकरणक लेल क्रमशः 600 आ 250 टका मे।

नागधुंगा-सिसनेखोला सुरंग-नेपाल केरऽ पहलऽ सड़क सुरंग-काठमांडू-नौबीसे सड़क खंड के साथ यात्रा के समय म॑ कमी ​​आरू सुरक्षित, सुविधाजनक, आरू टिकाऊ सड़क परिवहन प्रबंधन म॑ महत्वपूर्ण योगदान दै के उम्मीद छै । (आर एस एस) २.

full_article:
KATHMANDU, JULY 27

The Embassy of Bangladesh in Kathmandu on Sunday organised a mango festival showcasing the country's premium late-season mangoes and processed fruit products, aiming to strengthen agricultural trade and economic cooperation with Nepal.

The event, titled "Bangladesh Mango Delicacy", brought together around 250 participants, including diplomats, senior Nepali government officials, fruit importers, traders, business leaders and members of the media.

SAARC Secretary-General Md Golam Sarwar attended the event as the chief guest, while Gahendra Rajbhandari, Joint Secretary at Nepal's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, was the special guest.

Addressing the gathering, Bangladesh Ambassador Md Shafiqur Rahman said mangoes are an integral part of Bangladesh's culture, heritage and agricultural economy. He highlighted the country's internationally recognised varieties, including Khirsapat (Himsagar), Haribhanga, Langra, Fazli, Gopalbhog, Amrapali, Ashwina, Katimon and Gauramoti, noting their sweetness, aroma and nutritional value.

The ambassador also highlighted Bangladesh's progress in horticultural research and its expanding mango-processing industry, which produces products such as juices, pulp, jams, pickles, chutneys, dried mangoes and confectionery that meet international food safety standards.

Speaking at the event, SAARC Secretary-General Sarwar stressed the need for greater regional collaboration to promote South Asian mangoes in international markets, saying exports from the region remain below their potential. Rajbhandari praised the initiative, describing it as an example of "mango diplomacy" that helps deepen people-to-people ties and bilateral relations between Nepal and Bangladesh.

The exhibition featured fresh mangoes from Bangladesh's Rajshahi region, including Fazli, Amrapali, Bari-4, Katimon, Gauramoti and Ashwina varieties, alongside a range of processed products such as juices, pickles, jams, jellies and dried mangoes. Guests were also served mango-based desserts and traditional Bangladeshi cuisine.

Bangladeshi mango grower Rofiqul Islam shared his experience of more than 15 years in cultivating mangoes using Good Agricultural Practices (GAP), highlighting Bangladesh's advances in sustainable horticulture and modern farming techniques.

The embassy said the event sought to increase awareness among Nepali consumers and foster partnerships between exporters and importers of both countries, with the goal of expanding bilateral trade in fresh and processed agricultural products. It reaffirmed its commitment to promoting trade, investment and cultural exchanges between Nepal and Bangladesh.

राजदूत नँ बागवानी अनुसंधान मँ बांग्लादेश केरौ प्रगति आरू ओकरौ विस्तारित आम-प्रसंस्करण उद्योग प भी प्रकाश डाललकै, जे जूस, लुगदी, मुरब्बा, अचार, चटनी, सूखल आम आरू हलवाई जैसनौ उत्पाद के उत्पादन करै छै जे अंतरराष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा मानकौ प खरा उतरै छै ।

बांग्लादेशी आम उत्पादक रोफिकुल इस्लाम न॑ अच्छा कृषि प्रथा (जीएपी) के उपयोग करी क॑ आम के खेती म॑ १५ साल स॑ भी अधिक के अनुभव साझा करी क॑ टिकाऊ बागवानी आरू आधुनिक खेती तकनीक म॑ बांग्लादेश केरऽ प्रगति प॑ प्रकाश डाललकै ।

title: World Cup League 2: Nepal to face Namibia today - Khabarhub
description: World Cup League 2: Nepal to face Namibia today  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: Nepal will take on Namibia in the third match of the ongoing triangular ODI series under the ICC Cricket World Cup League 2 in the Netherlands on Monday, looking to recover from two consecutive defeats.

Nepal suffered back-to-back losses against Namibia and the Netherlands due to underwhelming performances in batting, bowling and fielding. The match against Namibia will begin at 4:45 pm Nepal time.

Nepal’s hopes of securing a top-four finish and advancing directly to the World Cup Global Qualifier have become increasingly difficult after failing to produce expected results in the opening matches.

In their first match of the series, Nepal lost to Namibia by eight wickets. After being sent in to bat, Nepal struggled from the beginning as Namibian bowler JJ Smith put pressure on the batting lineup. Nepal managed only 158 runs, which Namibia chased down in 37 overs, losing just two wickets.

Nepal then suffered a six-wicket defeat against the Netherlands in their second match. The hosts chased Nepal’s target of 158 runs in 35 overs with four wickets in hand.

Meanwhile, the Netherlands has strengthened its position in the league after recording two victories in the series. After defeating Nepal by six wickets in the opening match, the Netherlands beat Namibia by 58 runs on Saturday. The win lifted the Netherlands to third place with 36 points from 30 matches.

Nepal and Namibia, who have played the same number of matches, are currently tied on 24 points and occupy fifth and sixth positions, respectively.

Following Monday’s match against Namibia, Nepal will face the Netherlands on Wednesday. Nepal now needs victories in all remaining matches to keep its hopes alive for direct qualification to the World Cup.

काठमाण्डु, मिथिला मिरर: नीदरलैण्डमे भेल आईसीसी क्रिकेट विश्व कप लीग २ के अन्तर्गत जारी त्रिकोणीय एकदिवसीय श्रृंखलाके तेसर मैचमे नेपाल के बीच नामिबिया के बीच सोमदिन मुकाबला होयत, जाहिमे लगातार दू बेर हारसँ उबरबाक प्रयास कएल गेल अछि ।

बल्लेबाजी, गेंदबाजी आ फील्डिंग मे कमजोर प्रदर्शन के कारण नामीबिया आ नीदरलैंड के खिलाफ नेपाल के बैक टू बैक हार के सामना करय पड़ल छल. नामिबिया के खिलाफ मैच नेपाल समय साँझ ४:४५ बजे सँ शुरू होयत।

नेपाल केरऽ टॉप फोर म॑ जगह बनाबै के आरू सीधा विश्व कप ग्लोबल क्वालीफायर म॑ प्रवेश करै के आशा शुरुआती मैचऽ म॑ अपेक्षित परिणाम नै मिलला के बाद मुश्किल होय गेलऽ छै ।

सीरीज केरऽ पहलऽ मैच म॑ नेपाल नामिबिया स॑ आठ विकेट स॑ हारलऽ छेलै । बल्लेबाजी करै लेली भेजला के बाद नेपाल शुरू स॑ ही संघर्ष करलकै, कैन्हेंकि नामीबिया केरऽ गेंदबाज जे जे स्मिथ न॑ बल्लेबाजी केरऽ लाइनअप प॑ दबाव डाललकै । नेपाल मात्र १५८ रन बना सकल, जकरा नामीबिया ३७ ओवर मे पीछा कए मात्र २ विकेट गमा लेलक ।

एकरऽ बाद नेपाल क॑ अपनऽ दोसरऽ मैच म॑ नीदरलैंड के खिलाफ ६ विकेट के हार के सामना करना पड़लै । मेजबान टीम हाथ मे चारि विकेट लैत 35 ओवर मे 158 रन के नेपाल के लक्ष्य के पीछा केलक।

एम्हर, नीदरलैंड न॑ ई सीरीज म॑ दू जीत दर्ज करला के बाद लीग म॑ अपनऽ स्थिति मजबूत करी लेल॑ छै । उद्घाटन मैचमे नेपालके ६ विकेटसँ पराजित केलाक बाद शनिदिन नीदरलैण्ड नामिबियाके ५८ रनसँ पराजित केलक अछि । ई जीत स॑ नीदरलैंड न॑ ३० मैचऽ स॑ ३६ अंक प्राप्त करी क॑ तीसरा स्थान प॑ पहुँची गेलै ।

समान संख्यामे मैच खेलने नेपाल आ नामिबिया अखन २४ अंकमे बराबरीमे अछि आ क्रमशः पाँचम आ छठम स्थानमे अछि ।

सोमदिन नामीबिया के खिलाफ मैच के बाद बुधदिन नेपाल के मुकाबला नीदरलैंड सं होयत. नेपाल क॑ अब॑ विश्व कप लेली सीधा क्वालीफाइंग के आशा क॑ जीवित रखै लेली बाकी सब मैच म॑ जीत के जरूरत छै ।
